question: Seven boxes F, G, H, M, N, O and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. O is kept immediately above F. G is kept immediately above M. Only P is kept above N. Only two boxes are kept above O. G is not kept at third position from the bottom. How many boxes are kept between H and P?
solution:
Seven boxes F, G, H, M, N, O and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• O is kept immediately above F.
 
• G is kept immediately above M.
 
• Only P is kept above N.
 
• Only two boxes are kept above O.

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
P

 
 
 

 
 
N

 
 
 

 
 
O

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
H

 
 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
M

 
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
